$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema.

url.description: SQLAlchemy URL for the RAG database (psycopg3 driver).

hnsw_ef_search.description: HNSW probe width at query time. Higher is better recall, slower.

name.description: Display name of the corpus owner.

identities.description: Identities belonging to the owner as 'kind:value' strings, e.g. 'git_email:me@example.com'. Anything authored by an identity NOT listed here is treated as reference rather than authored.

ollama_host.description: Base URL of the Ollama server for embeddings, fact distillation and answers. May be another machine; communications are only ever sent to a loopback host.

lmstudio_host.description: Base URL of the LM Studio OpenAI-compatible API (include /v1); embeddings, fact distillation, answers, and model management under /api/v1. May be another machine; communications are only ever sent to a loopback host.

llama_host.description: Base URL of the llama.cpp HTTP API served by the app's LlamaXPCService (loopback only).

lmstudio_api_token_file.description: Path to an LM Studio API token for an authenticated server. The token itself is kept outside this configuration file; GARAGE_LMSTUDIO_API_TOKEN overrides it.

default_model.description: Slug of the model used when a command does not name one. Must be registered with 'garage register-model' first.

overlap.description: Characters repeated between adjacent prose chunks, so a sentence spanning a boundary is still retrievable.

code_size.description: Target characters per code chunk. Larger, to keep functions intact.

code_overlap.description: Characters repeated between adjacent code chunks.

materialize.description: Download cloud placeholder files when encountered. Reading a stub asks the provider to fetch it, so a large online-only folder can mean hundreds of gigabytes. Bounded by the limits below.

limit.description: Files materialized per run; 0 means unlimited.

max_bytes.description: Byte budget per run; 0 means unlimited.

timeout_seconds.description: Give up on a single download that never arrives. A stalled provider cannot be cancelled, so this stops it blocking the run.

max_chunks_per_document.description: Backstop so no single document can dominate the index.

reject_machine_generated.description: Reject logs, dumps, and checksum manifests by content shape.

max_file_bytes.description: Skip files larger than this; usually archives or disk images.

pdf_min_chars_per_page.description: Below this, escalate a PDF page from pypdf to pdfplumber.

ocr_min_chars.description: Below this many characters an image is treated as having no text. Most images in a source tree are icons.

host.description: Bind address. This server has no authentication and exposes the whole corpus, so a non-loopback address needs --allow-remote.

path.description: HTTP route the MCP endpoint is served on.

model.description: Slug or alias of the local model used for fact distillation ('garage enrich-facts') and for the rag_ask / rag_generate MCP tools. For llama_xpc this is the alias the app loaded the model under (the 'fact_distil' preset slug); for ollama it is the Ollama model name; for lmstudio it is the LM Studio model key (e.g. 'google/gemma-3-4b').

provider.description: Which inference server runs fact distillation and rag_ask: 'llama_xpc' is the app's LlamaXPCService (llama.cpp on embedding.llama_host, loopback only); 'ollama' is the Ollama server on embedding.ollama_host; 'lmstudio' is the LM Studio server on embedding.lmstudio_host, which loads the model on first use. Communications are only ever sent to a loopback host.

items.description: A named fact-extraction prompt, as written in ``facts.prompts``.

name.description: Unique name, recorded on every fact the prompt produces. The name of a built-in prompt ('default') overrides it instead of adding a new one.
name.title: Name

description.description: The instructions given to the model. Required for a new prompt; an override of a built-in may leave it out to keep the built-in's.
description.title: Description

examples.description: Few-shot examples (LangExtract's shape: text plus expected extractions). Required, and not empty, for a new prompt; an override of a built-in may leave it out to keep the built-in's.
examples.title: Examples

corpus_classes.description: Corpus classes the prompt runs on (document, code, communication); empty means all.
corpus_classes.title: Corpus Classes

sources.description: Source slugs the prompt runs on; empty means every source.
sources.title: Sources

enabled.description: Set false to stop running this prompt.
enabled.title: Enabled

items.title: FactPrompt

prompts.description: Fact-extraction prompts for 'garage enrich-facts', each a name, a description (the instructions), few-shot examples and an optional scope. Merged by name with the built-in 'default' prompt: an entry named 'default' overrides it (fields left out keep the built-in's; enabled false turns it off), and any other entry is added. Every enabled prompt that applies to a document runs; 'garage facts prompts list' shows the result.

sources.description: Sources to index. Declared sources are re-applied on every run; sources present only in the database are left untouched.

root.description: Directory or file to index. '~' is expanded.

include_code.description: Index source files as well as documents.

enabled.description: Set false to skip this source.

FactExample.description: A few-shot example: a text and what should be extracted from it.

extractions.description: The extractions expected from the text, in the order they appear.
extractions.title: Extractions

FactExample.title: FactExample

FactExtractionExample.description: One extraction the model should produce from an example's text.

class.description: Label for what kind of thing this is; stored as facts.fact_class.
class.title: Class

text.description: The extraction, quoted exactly from the example's text.
text.title: Text

attributes.description: Optional attributes the model should attach; stored as facts.attributes.
attributes.title: Attributes

FactExtractionExample.title: FactExtractionExample
